items.html: But with what was stated above, the three of them are true. For in the aspect of Rachel, who descended below into Beria and has no coupling with her husband ZA, they said that they delight in the souls of the righteous, and hear the voice of those who engage in Torah at Chatzot. And in the aspect of Leah, who couples with Yaakov, they said that ZON couple at Chatzot; and this too is called delighting with the souls, as above, at the beginning of this discourse, for it is the matter of the ascent of the souls in the secret of MAN to Leah. And since Yaakov and Leah are the secret of the posteriors themselves and of AVI, as is explained by us, for therefore Leah is called the hidden world; therefore they mentioned it by the name of the coupling of AVI. But it is nothing but the coupling of Yaakov and Leah.
